text: Studio signed off the CR6 sketch on 2026-09-26 with decisions (1)-(5) as proposed, plus four amendments. C1 (CR6b): every Phrase token carries a typed role (query/reference/match/control/scale/metric/policy) as well as its FieldId, so Studio styles tokens without parsing English. C2 (CR6b): core owns advisories. FieldView exposes derived read-only facts (cell size in both units, sigma in cells) and typed Advisory findings (Warning, keyed by StudyField, naming operands), e.g. sigma below about 1.5 cells, or sigma near-uniform over the image. Whole-recipe errors keyed by StudyField sit in the same place. C3 (new slice CR6d): MethodsText takes typed fact slots filled from the UI-C Report and from run and inspection values (eligible queries, records outside the window, n per group, dataset revision); the slot types live in plan, and the renderer that fills them lives in eyes4s-results. C4 (CR6a): each FormField validates on its own (raw to value, or a bound refusal) without a whole valid recipe; whole-recipe checks run on demand.
